message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow will build a Java project with Maven, and cache/restore any dependencies to improve the workflow execution time
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/building-and-testing-java-with-maven

name: Java CI with Maven

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master" ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - name: Set up JDK 21
      uses: actions/setup-java@v6
      with:
        java-version: '21'
        distribution: 'temurin'
        cache: maven
    - name: Build with Maven
      run: mvn -B clean org.jacoco:jacoco-maven-plugin:prepare-agent verify appengine:stage --file pom.xml
    - name: Run Codacy Coverage Reporter
      uses: codacy/codacy-coverage-reporter-action@v1.3.0
      with:
        project-token: ${{ secrets.CODACY_PROJECT_TOKEN }}
        coverage-reports: 'target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml'
",
  "rationale": "Adding concurrency cancellation for superseded runs on the same pull request reduces duplicate work when new commits are pushed, saving CI resources. This is supported by pattern P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (literature simulation estimate showing VM time reduction). The workflow meets preconditions: runs represent the same workflow and PR, newer revisions supersede older checks. No contraindications apply (not a release/deployment workflow). The change preserves all build and test coverage.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
